301 :         self, component, name=None, before=None, after=None, first=None, last=None
302 :     ):

304 :         callables that take a `Doc` object, modify it and return it. Only one
305 :         of before/after/first/last can be set. Default behaviour is "last".
306 : 
307 :         component (callable): The pipeline component.
308 :         name (unicode): Name of pipeline component. Overwrites existing
309 :             component.name attribute if available. If no name is set and
310 :             the component exposes no name attribute, component.__name__ is
311 :             used. An error is raised if a name already exists in the pipeline.
312 :         before (unicode): Component name to insert component directly before.
313 :         after (unicode): Component name to insert component directly after.
314 :         first (bool): Insert component first / not first in the pipeline.
315 :         last (bool): Insert component last / not last in the pipeline.
316 : 
317 :         DOCS: https://spacy.io/api/language#add_pipe
318 :         """
319 :         if not hasattr(component, "__call__"):
320 :             msg = Errors.E003.format(component=repr(component), name=name)
321 :             if isinstance(component, basestring_) and component in self.factories:
322 :                 msg += Errors.E004.format(component=component)
323 :             raise ValueError(msg)
324 :         if name is None:
325 :             name = util.get_component_name(component)
326 :         if name in self.pipe_names:
327 :             raise ValueError(Errors.E007.format(name=name, opts=self.pipe_names))
328 :         if sum([bool(before), bool(after), bool(first), bool(last)]) >= 2:
329 :             raise ValueError(Errors.E006)
330 :         pipe_index = 0
331 :         pipe = (name, component)
332 :         if last or not any([first, before, after]):
333 :             pipe_index = len(self.pipeline)
334 :             self.pipeline.append(pipe)
335 :         elif first:
336 :             self.pipeline.insert(0, pipe)
337 :         elif before and before in self.pipe_names:
338 :             pipe_index = self.pipe_names.index(before)
339 :             self.pipeline.insert(self.pipe_names.index(before), pipe)
340 :         elif after and after in self.pipe_names:
341 :             pipe_index = self.pipe_names.index(after) + 1
342 :             self.pipeline.insert(self.pipe_names.index(after) + 1, pipe)
343 :         else:
344 :             raise ValueError(
345 :                 Errors.E001.format(name=before or after, opts=self.pipe_names)
346 :             )
347 :         if ENABLE_PIPELINE_ANALYSIS:
348 :             analyze_pipes(self.pipeline, name, component, pipe_index)"

Conclusion: The test `spacy.tests.pipeline.test_analysis.test_analysis_validate_attrs_remove_pipe()` checks whether attributes are validated correctly when removing a pipeline component. The failure indicates that there is an issue with the binary compatibility of the 'thinc.extra.search.Beam' size, which was expected to be 120 but got 112 from PyObject. Upon examining the code snippet for `spacy.language.Language.add_pipe()`, we find no explicit handling of binary compatibility checks in the method that adds or removes pipes. Therefore, the issue might lie within the component being added (`c2`) or the way it interacts with other components and dependencies.
```
